"""Read-only provider boundary reproduction for PharmacophoreMT ownership audit."""

import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import molsysmt as msm
import numpy as np
from molsysmt.native import Structures

from pharmacophoremt import pyunitwizard as puw

origins = [[0.0, 0.0, 0.0], [10.961, 1.2027, 2.2746], [-100.0, 200.0, -300.0]]
provider = Path(msm.__file__).resolve().parent.parent
fit_path = provider / 'molsysmt/structure/least_rmsd_fit.py'
fit_hash = hashlib.sha256(fit_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
records = []
for raw_origin in origins:
    origin = np.asarray(raw_origin)
    degenerate = np.array([origin, origin, origin + [-0.6796666666666666, 0.4689333333333333, 0.17735]])
    valid = np.array([origin, origin + [1.0, 0.0, 0.0], origin + [0.0, 1.0, 0.0]])
    for name, first, second in [('degenerate_source', degenerate, valid), ('degenerate_target', valid, degenerate), ('valid_self', valid, valid)]:
        source = Structures(coordinates=puw.quantity([first], 'nm'))
        target = Structures(coordinates=puw.quantity([second], 'nm'))
        source_snapshot = puw.get_value(msm.get(source, coordinates=True), to_unit='nm').copy()
        target_snapshot = puw.get_value(msm.get(target, coordinates=True), to_unit='nm').copy()
        record = dict(case=name, origin_nm=raw_origin, source_nm=first.tolist(), target_nm=second.tolist(),
                      source_distinct_centers=len(np.unique(first, axis=0)), target_distinct_centers=len(np.unique(second, axis=0)),
                      source_anchored_rank=int(np.linalg.matrix_rank(first - first[0])), target_anchored_rank=int(np.linalg.matrix_rank(second - second[0])),
                      source_mean_centered_rank=int(np.linalg.matrix_rank(first - first.mean(axis=0))), target_mean_centered_rank=int(np.linalg.matrix_rank(second - second.mean(axis=0))))
        try:
            fitted = msm.structure.least_rmsd_fit(source, selection=[0, 1, 2], selection_fit=[0, 1, 2],
                                                reference_molecular_system=target, reference_selection_fit=[0, 1, 2],
                                                in_place=False, precision='double', use_gpu=False)
        except Exception as error:
            record.update(outcome='rejected', error_type=type(error).__name__, error=str(error))
        else:
            record.update(outcome='accepted', fitted_coordinates_nm=puw.get_value(msm.get(fitted, coordinates=True), to_unit='nm').tolist())
        record['source_unchanged'] = np.array_equal(source_snapshot, puw.get_value(msm.get(source, coordinates=True), to_unit='nm'))
        record['target_unchanged'] = np.array_equal(target_snapshot, puw.get_value(msm.get(target, coordinates=True), to_unit='nm'))
        assert record['source_unchanged'] and record['target_unchanged']
        records.append(record)
assert all(r['outcome'] == 'accepted' for r in records if r['case'] == 'valid_self')
assert any(r['outcome'] == 'accepted' for r in records if r['case'] != 'valid_self')
assert fit_hash == hashlib.sha256(fit_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
execution = Path(__file__).read_text()
report = dict(schema='pharmacophoremt.provider_fit_ownership_audit@1', python=sys.version, executable=sys.executable,
              provider_version=msm.__version__, provider_head=subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(provider), 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip(),
              provider_upstream=subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(provider), 'rev-parse', 'origin/main'], text=True).strip(),
              fit_source_sha256=fit_hash, fit_source_unchanged=True,
              molecular_extensions=[dict(module=name, path=module.__file__, sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(module.__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest())
                  for name, module in sorted(sys.modules.items()) if name.startswith('molsysmt.') and getattr(module, '__file__', None) and Path(module.__file__).suffix in {'.so', '.pyd', '.dylib'}],
              records=records, execution_source=execution, execution_sha256=hashlib.sha256(execution.encode()).hexdigest(),
              limits='Executed local provider only; upstream fit source inspected as identical. No upstream execution, performance or near-collinearity threshold qualification.')
Path('/tmp/phmt-provider-fit-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + '\n')
print(json.dumps([dict(case=r['case'], origin=r['origin_nm'], outcome=r['outcome']) for r in records]))
